about: L4 after task 6: a trophy cover (aria-label "Cover: ...") counts by itself; besides that, lines that count as a results or trophy moment on the event page (counts), and lines that look like one but aren't about this meet (ignore). Regexes, case-insensitive.

counts.why: A clear time the results come ("Results at 23:00").
The results header ("Demo: how Best car went").

ignore.why: Last week's meet row, not this meet.
